description: This file defines the ModelCondition interface in the org.apache.ofbiz.widget.model package, specifying methods for accepting a visitor and evaluating a condition based on a context map.

classes.name: ModelCondition
classes.description: An interface representing a model condition that can be evaluated within a given context and can accept a visitor.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor that implements ModelConditionVisitor, allowing external operations on the condition.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the condition against the provided context map, returning true or false.
